scenarios.boundary: One active host may select one exact hash-bound owner from strongly evidenced alternatives; validation itself creates no run.
A path absent from the canonical packet is rejected and cannot create a Planning Lock.
Every material path claim must cite a packet edge that touches the exact candidate.
A changed content fingerprint invalidates the proposal before any run is created.
Host reasoning is evidence refinement only and cannot request approval, a Planning Lock, writes, or execution.
